messages:
alex: Quick async standup — drop what you did yesterday, any blockers, and today's focus. I'll start: finished draft of the routing + cache TTL spec, ran perf sim on staging; blocker = need decision on cache TTL tradeoff (latency vs cost) by EOD. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/320

maria: yesterday — validated embed cache eviction scenario with synthetic workload, found a case where KV miss rate spikes at sequence breaks. no blocking deploys. today — pair with Alex to pick TTL, and then I'll add e2e test.

kevin: yesterday — reviewed alex's PR, left comments on the fallback policy section (see inline). main ask: can we expose a simple knob for devs to prefer latency over cost? blocked on answers to the knob semantics. pinged @alex on review. :eyes:

sara: FYI — product wants a note in the spec about rollout plan for Dedicated customers (they expect opt-in knob). Also one UX ask: make the default in Console show estimated cost delta for 24/48/72h. I can draft the text.

luis: yesterday — merged small batching fix that reduced median p99 by ~30ms on small inputs. today — will add telemetry to measure effective batch sizes across regions. no blockers.

kevin: quick ping — alex can you clarify if TTL = prefix cache time or full KV lifetime? impacts the eviction strategy.

alex: TTL here = KV lifetime for cached prefixes (not per-request prefix TTL). main tradeoff: shorter KV lifetime lowers stale outputs but increases token compute/cost. proposal: default 5m, opt-in profiles for 30s (low latency) and 30m (cost-saving).

maria: +1 to profiles. can we add a controlled experiment tag so we can A/B compare quality regressions?

alex: yes — will add a rollout plan section with canary tag and eval hooks. sample config snippet I'll add to the PR: ```yaml
cache_profiles:
  - name: low-latency
    kv_ttl_sec: 30
    batch_target: 8
  - name: balanced
    kv_ttl_sec: 300
    batch_target: 16
  - name: cost-saver
    kv_ttl_sec: 1800
    batch_target: 32
```

sara: that looks good. product wants the Console to show estimated cost delta for each profile, and call out behavior for Dedicated vs Hosted.

kevin: thanks. I've posted a small follow-up in the PR with a question about the default batch_target for small-seq models.

dev-bot: deploy-notice: staging deploy started for platform@rc-2026-03-17 (includes alex/pr-320 and kevin/batching-fix). CI: passing so far.

alex: awesome — thanks team. action items: (1) I'll update PR with profiles + rollout plan + canary tags by noon EST, (2) Maria to add e2e test for sequence-break miss, (3) Sara to draft Console copy, (4) Kevin will finalize review on batch_target. If you need a sync, I'll be available 1:30–2:00pm. otherwise we can iterate here. :thumbsup:
